purpose: DESIGN ONLY, SHADOW. Owner decisions 2026-10-20 §1/§5: an informational disclosure; geom_q078_v1, canonical values, verdicts and fairness thresholds unchanged. Nothing here is served.

rules.A_dependence: the package a team RECEIVES holds >= 1 low-value depth (LVD) piece other than its single highest-valued piece, and removing those LVD pieces changes that team's fairness REGION (disfavoured / fair / favoured) under geom_q078_v1 + fairness_bands
rules.A_dependence_public: as A_dependence, but only a change of the public FAIR / NOT FAIR state counts (fair <-> not fair; a change of direction alone does not)
rules.A_guarded: A_dependence, and the trade also holds >= 1 piece that is NOT low-value depth (a trade made only of low-value pieces never fires) - the guard was added after the unsweetened low-tier bases were seen firing (design §3.4), and is reported separately
rules.A_guarded_public: A_guarded with A_dependence_public's FAIR / NOT FAIR change
rules.A_guarded_publicFairOnly: A_guarded_public restricted to a team whose result is FAIR and becomes NOT FAIR without its LVD extras (never fires on a NOT FAIR result, so the disclosure cannot reveal which way a NOT FAIR trade leans - privacy M4)
rules.B_share25: the received package has >= 2 pieces and its LVD pieces other than the top piece carry >= 25% of its raw priced value (X is a PRIOR, not tuned)
rules.C_extraPieces: the received package has more pieces than the package given in return, and at least one of its (n_received - n_given) lowest-valued pieces is LVD
rules.naive_B: COMPARATOR ONLY (research §11 rejected it): the B_currency_replacement treatment's signed level differs from GEOM_78's

lvdDefinition.prereg: players - not a genuine starter (league optimal lineup, or unrostered >= the lowest league starter at the position) and value < anchor[pos]; pick: value < anchor['*']
lvdDefinition.floor: players - value < min(anchor[pos], lowest league starter at pos); pick: value < anchor['*']
lvdDefinition.missing: no value, no position or no anchor for the position = unclassifiable -> the rule is NOT evaluated (no disclosure), never treated as zero or as low

design.groups: '<cat>' = every case whose 1-4 sweeteners are of that §3 class (current anchors, the study's own labels); '|flip' = the incumbent verdict crosses a region for the sweetening side (the S3 primary flip, i.e. 'filler-caused flip' when cat = filler); '|noflip' = it does not; '|starterOnlyBase' = every base asset is a genuine starter; '|madeFair' = the sweeteners turned a result AGAINST the sweetening side into FAIR (the public 'unfair made fair' case)
design.sweetenerAttributable: fires on the SWEETENED package and did not fire on that same package before the sweeteners were added

P2_calculatorSample.population: S5a: top-500 non-quarantined board assets; 1-3 v na..min(na+4,7); raw gap <= 25% of the larger side; values are % of trades on which the rule fires for either team

P3_ownLeagueTrades.population: every team side (got vs gave) of the own-league trades in the newest archive's sleeper.trades, valued with TODAY's board (not at-the-time values); a side with any unpriced piece is NOT evaluated (never priced at zero)

P4_warRoom.note: rules are evaluated on the MARKET (asset-only) fairness of the trade; the served Team-Context verdict is reported beside it, never changed
